intro.headline: Realtime Space Travel
intro.paragraph1: The last ark of humanity stands ready at the launch pad. This is not a game — the survival of our species depends on this voyage. A new home awaits in distant star systems, but the journey will demand everything we have. There is no second chance.
intro.paragraph2: The entire crew — scientists, engineers, the founders of a new civilization — has entered cryogenic sleep. Their fate, their dreams, our future... all entrusted to you. You are the one awake. The one watching. The one who must see us through.
intro.sectionTitle: Your Duties – The Mission's Strictest Protocols
intro.rule1: <1>The Vigilance Protocol</1> – continuous visual monitoring is required to stabilize the navigation data. If your attention breaks, the ship initiates an emergency shutdown.
intro.rule2: <1>The Zero-Intervention Principle</1> – the systems are self-sustaining; manual intervention can be fatal. Your most important skill is discipline and patience. Do not act – supervise!
intro.rule3: <1>Real-Time Travel</1> – experience the authentic reality of interstellar travel. The stars shift over millennia; your greatest enemy is time.
intro.rule4: <1>The stakes: Everything.</1> No glory, no battles, no rewards – only silence, the infinite cosmos, and the responsibility resting on your shoulders. The future is reflected in your eyes.
intro.continue: Click or press any key to continue.

cameraConsent.title: Camera Access
cameraConsent.description:
This game uses face recognition to track your attention during the mission.

Your camera feed is processed entirely on your device. No images or video are ever sent to any server, stored, or shared with third parties.

You can enable or disable camera access at any time in the Settings menu.

cameraHelp.title: Allowing the camera in your browser
cameraHelp.intro: Your browser has blocked the camera for this site. For security reasons only you can undo this in the browser settings — the game cannot ask for permission again.

chrome.name: Chrome / Edge / Brave / Opera
chrome.step1: Click the icon at the left end of the address bar (a lock or sliders icon).
chrome.step2: Turn the “Camera” switch on, or choose “Reset permissions”.
chrome.step3: Reload the page, then start the game again — the browser prompt will appear.

firefox.name: Firefox
firefox.step1: Click the lock icon at the left end of the address bar.
firefox.step2: Next to “Use the Camera: Blocked”, click the × to clear the block.
firefox.step3: Reload the page, then start the game again — the browser prompt will appear.

safari.name: Safari
safari.step2: Find this site in the list and set it to “Ask” or “Allow”.
safari.step3: Reload the page, then start the game again — the browser prompt will appear.

generic.name: Other browser
generic.step1: Open your browser's site settings for this page (usually via the icon next to the address bar).
generic.step2: Find the camera permission and allow it, or reset it to the default.
generic.step3: Reload the page, then start the game again — the browser prompt will appear.

cameraHelp.reloadNote: The change only takes effect after the page is reloaded.

nomadX1.desc: The Nomad X1 is a reliable entry-level starship built by Orion Shipyards. Despite its compact size, it is surprisingly fast, ideal for shorter missions.

vegaRunner.desc: The Vega Runner is the pride of Helios Dynamics' engineers. It offers balanced performance and long range, suitable for medium-distance expeditions.

aetherTitan.desc: The Aether Titan is Nova Consortium's flagship starship. Its immense speed and capacity make even the most distant star systems accessible.

redStar.desc: A rugged, industrial starship from Krasnyi Kosmos — built to endure the harshest conditions. With reinforced hull plating and redundant systems, the Red Star never quits.

nebulaPioneer.desc: The Nebula Pioneer is Orion Shipyards' latest mid-range explorer. Designed for deep-space reconnaissance with advanced sensor suites and a comfortable crew quarters.

quantumVoyager.desc: Helios Dynamics' quantum-drive prototype. The Voyager boasts unprecedented energy efficiency, allowing for extended missions into uncharted nebula regions.

brassMonarch.desc: A marvel of retro-futuristic engineering from Steamforge Atelier. The Brass Monarch combines Victorian-era aesthetics with cutting-edge propulsion technology.

cosmosSeeker.desc: Nova Consortium's ultra-long-range exploration vessel. Equipped with a state-of-the-art gravity drive and extensive laboratory facilities for deep-space research.

xenomorph.desc: A mysterious bio-engineered vessel of unknown origin. The Xenomorph's organic hull regenerates over time, and its neural interface adapts to the pilot's thoughts.

voidWalker.desc: The Void Walker glides through the darkest reaches of space with eerie silence. Its alien engines consume cosmic radiation, granting it near-limitless range.

starSong.desc: Orion Shipyards' melodic marvel — the Star Song resonates with stellar harmonics. Its smooth, efficient drive makes every journey a symphony of precision.

siberianStorm.desc: Krasnyi Kosmos' cold-weather titan. Designed for extreme conditions, the Siberian Storm has double-reinforced hulls and engines that thrive in planetary blizzards.

santasSleigh.desc: The legendary gift-delivery vessel from the North Pole Workshop. Powered by festive cheer and advanced warp technology, it is the fastest ship in the galaxy during winter.

giftCarrier.desc: North Pole Workshop's bulk freighter, capable of carrying an entire workshop's production. With its wide cargo bay and sturdy construction, no present is too large.

ironBaron.desc: Steamforge Atelier's most ambitious creation — a flying fortress of brass and iron. The Iron Baron combines Victorian grandeur with devastating industrial power.

phantom.desc: A ghost ship from beyond known space. The Phantom's drives emit no signature, and its hull bends light around it — perfect for pilots who prefer to go unnoticed.

starPhoenix.desc: Nova Consortium's rebirth from the ashes of earlier prototypes. The Star Phoenix rises with revolutionary engine tech and a command deck that anticipates the captain's every command.

asdasd123.desc: ⚠️ DEBUG SHIP ⚠️ You shouldn't be seeing this. 1234 km/s. 1234 credits. No questions asked. 'It's not a bug — it's a feature.' — Debug Dynamics Ltd.

longDrop.desc:
The Latrina Aerospace LD-42 "Long Drop" combines traditional rural craftsmanship with cutting-edge interstellar engineering. Every vessel is hand-built from reclaimed heritage hardwood and engineered to withstand both warp travel and... other kinds of pressure.

Manufacturer: Latrina Aerospace
Model: LD-42 "Long Drop"

Crew: 1-2
